videos.title: Lecture 1: Introduction and Lumped Abstraction
videos.notes: Best conceptual intro to current/voltage/element laws; physics-light framing suits a student with no physics. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 2: Basic Circuit Analysis Method
videos.notes: Covers KVL/KCL method, series/parallel, dividers and introduces the node method; rewatch the node-method half in week 3. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 3: Superposition, Thevenin and Norton
videos.notes: Direct match for OSU weeks 6-7 theorems. Does not do max power transfer or dependent-source Thevenin drills. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 4: The Digital Abstraction
videos.notes: Digital logic levels; not in ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 5: Inside the Digital Gate
videos.notes: Only relevant as a circuit-level view of the MOSFET for the semiconductor-devices intro; no fabrication content. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 6: Nonlinear Analysis
videos.notes: Nonlinear analysis is beyond ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 7: Incremental Analysis
videos.notes: Small-signal/incremental analysis is beyond ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 8: Dependent Sources and Amplifiers
videos.notes: Introduces dependent sources, then moves to MOSFET amplifiers that assume Lectures 5-7. Use for the concept; get dependent-source analysis practice from the supplemental picks. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 9: MOSFET Amplifier Large Signal Analysis (part 1)
videos.notes: MOSFET amplifiers; not in ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 9: MOSFET Amplifier Large Signal Analysis (part 2)
videos.notes: MOSFET amplifiers; not in ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 10: Amplifiers - Small Signal Model
videos.notes: Small-signal amplifiers; not in ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 11: Small Signal Circuits
videos.notes: Small-signal amplifiers; not in ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 12: Capacitors and First-Order Systems
videos.notes: Core RC transient lecture. Inductors get far less airtime in 6.002 videos, so pair with the RL picks. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 13: Digital Circuit Speed
videos.notes: Applies first-order RC step response to gate delay; extra RC practice wrapped in digital context. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 14: State and Memory
videos.notes: Uses the idea of capacitor voltage as state (initial conditions), useful for transient problems; the digital-memory part can be skipped. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 15: Second-Order Systems (part 1)
videos.notes: Second-order circuits are ECE 202 material. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 15: Second-Order Systems (part 2)
videos.notes: Second-order circuits are ECE 202 material. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 16: Sinusoidal Steady State
videos.notes: AC analysis is ECE 202. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 17: The Impedance Model
videos.notes: AC analysis is ECE 202. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 18: Filters
videos.notes: AC/frequency response is ECE 202. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 19: The Operational Amplifier Abstraction
videos.notes: Ideal op-amp model and the basic feedback amplifiers; direct match for OSU week 8. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 20: Operational Amplifier Circuits
videos.notes: Multiple-input op-amp circuits plus integrators/differentiators (ties op-amps to capacitors). Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 21: Op Amps Positive Feedback
videos.notes: Positive feedback/oscillators are beyond ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 22: Energy and Power
videos.notes: Energy stored in C (and dissipated in RC charging); supports the capacitor/inductor energy formulas. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 23: Energy, CMOS
videos.notes: CMOS at circuit level; optional context for the semiconductor-devices intro. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.

videos.title: Lecture 25: Violating the Abstraction Barrier
videos.notes: Course capstone; not needed for ECE 201. Duration from YouTube watch-page lengthSeconds; transcript (PDF and VTT captions) linked from the OCW lecture page.
